page.overview:
Who is Abhorash?

Abhorash, also called the "Dragon Slayer", the "Scourge of the Greenskins", the "Blade Immortal", the "Lord of Blood", the "Great Dragon", the "Red Dragon", "Abhorash the Great", "Abhorash the Wanderer", and "Abhorash the Master", is a Trueborn Vampire and a Vampire Lord who is the founder and the most legendary of all Blood Dragons, the infamous bloodline of Vampiric knights known for its martial prowess.

There are two mutually contradictory accounts of Abhorash's early history and his activities following the fall of the ancient Nehekharan city-state of Lahmia where the first Vampires were born. Both are presented below.

Abhorash was the captain of the palace guard in the ancient Nehekharan city-state of Lahmia, serving Queen Neferatem. In love with the queen he was sworn to protect, he was horrified once he discovered her true nature as a Vampire.

For her desire, he sought out victims to sate her blood thirst. For her protection, he sought out criminals and enemies, so the people would not rise up against their lords. And for her favour, he too drank of the flawed Elixir of Life she had created and joined his mistress across death's divide. He was the first to join W'soran and Neferatem as Trueborn Vampires.
